title: 1.4 release readiness umbrella - clear the gates before cutting 1.4.0
description: There is no pre-release tier in this project (one GitHub-only release flow, see the mpi-release skill), so this card IS the pre-release: the gate list that must be clear before /mpi-version-bump stamps 1.4.0. 1.4 is the biggest feature release since 1.0 - the whole canvas toolkit (mask tools, Paint, Composite, Adjust, ten brushes, shapes), the Control operation replacing Depth, localised edit on four models, plus an engine-provision rewrite - and UNRELEASED.md already carries every claim. The gates are grouped: A must-fix code (MPI-420, MPI-404, MPI-410, MPI-374), B must-verify with no code expected (MPI-249 Linux leg on the real artifact, MPI-432 mac pinch, both test suites), C must-decide so the notes are not false (MPI-433 date gate, MPI-416 macOS split, a claim audit of UNRELEASED.md), D board and version hygiene. Full gate table with the reasoning per member is in brief.md; the tick-list is checklist.md.
acceptance: Gate A: MPI-420, MPI-404, MPI-410 and MPI-374 are each closed or explicitly deferred with the deferral written into the release notes as a known issue - not left silently open
Gate B: both test suites green (npm test + npm run test:desktop), and the Linux leg of MPI-249 run against the REAL 1.4 artifact, not a dev checkout
Gate C: every claim in UNRELEASED.md is either verified or reworded to what was verified - no fix bullet describes a fix nobody has run
Gate D: board coherent (MPI-440 closed, MPI-4 and MPI-259 out of doing, validate_board.py exit 0) and npm run release:check passes at 1.4.0
The release is cut only after every gate above reads closed or consciously waived by the user, with the waiver recorded on this card
